brief:
Israeli military censorship approved release of previously unseen footage showing the Bazan oil refinery in Haifa Bay struck by Iranian ballistic missiles during confrontations last year, Shehab Wire reported. The video documents the moment of impact as multiple rounds of ordnance struck the facility with visible force.

The footage marks the first public disclosure of detailed imagery from the ballistic missile strikes on the complex. Israel's military censor had restricted distribution of such recordings until now, controlling what images from the incident could reach media and public audiences. The refinery, a key energy infrastructure site, sustained direct hits during the Iranian attacks, though the precise date of the strikes was not specified in the released material.
